description: Turns the Development preview's link off, the way the dashboard's Preview link switch does: no link opens the preview, old or new, and every device that opened it is cut off. It stays off: only the founder can open the preview, signed in to Gemmein. site_share_link with on: true turns it back on with a new link (anything shared before stays dead). The site's files and the version it serves don't change. Development only — the Live site is public and has no preview link. Development caps how many a day. On the founder's Logs.
name: site_revoke_previews
title: Turn the preview link off
